messages:
maria: quick heads-up 1: I opened PR that consolidates quota + pricing examples under a single 'metering' section. main work: clarify v2 header, add migration checklist, and add a worked monthly-cost example. can ppl scan for factual issues?
noah: skimmed. two requests: 1) explicit formula for burst-credit consumption (we've seen confusion) and 2) clarify rounding policy (we bill by metered-unit, rounding up to next 1000 tokens).
tom: sdk note: update the cURL and Go snippets to use the standard sdk header helpers where possible. i'll add a small Go snippet showing header builder in the sdk repo after merge.
anya: product note: Dedicated customers need a note about local enforcement of quota headers (they may be managed via env var on private installs). suggest a short callout: "Dedicated/Private: server-side compatibility may vary; test in staging."
maria: good points. i'll add the burst formula as a step-by-step worked calc and a tiny table example. also adding the Dedicated callout. here's a draft worked example to paste into docs:

Worked example (monthly estimate):
1) measured tokens/day = 150,000 tokens
2) metered unit size = 1,000 tokens (round up)
3) daily metered units = ceil(150000 / 1000) = 150 units
4) monthly metered units (30d) = 150 * 30 = 4,500 units
5) price per unit = $0.0075 -> monthly = 4500 * 0.0075 = $33.75

noah: that's clear. maybe add a tiny worked burst example:
- burst credits available: 2,000 tokens
- single request consumes 6,200 tokens
- consumption after applying burst = max(0, 6200 - 2000) = 4,200 -> billed as ceil(4200/1000) = 5 units

maria: added that. also added a short note about "metered_consumption" metric mapping and a sample Grafana PromQL to use in docs panels: 

Grafana (Prometheus) example:
```
sum by(route) (rate(metered_consumption_total{service="api"}[5m]))
```
note: use "route" label to split endpoints.

tom: thanks. can we include a cURL example showing header syntax? i'll mirror it in the SDK docs later.

maria: cURL snippet added:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "X-Redwood-Metering: tier=team;burst=2000" \ 
  -d '{"prompt":"Explain token metering"}'
```
maria: also adding a Go http example (small) so folks on platform can copy: 
```
client := &http.Client{}
req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", strings.NewReader(`{"prompt":"Hello"}`))
req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
req.Header.Set("X-Redwood-Metering", "tier=team;burst=2000")
resp, _ := client.Do(req)
_ = resp
```
anya: looks good. docs-bot created DOCS-4811 for the migration banner; please add the small red banner copy: "Metering v2: update your headers by 2026-06-01 to continue receiving burst credits and tiered pricing."
docs-bot: DOCS-4811 created and linked to PR #3421 (assignee: maria).
infra-bot: FYI: Dedicated staging image updated (metering-v2-enabled). run validation job: /infra/validate-metering v2 --staging
maria: pinging infra run now; can someone confirm results when job completes? i'll hold merge until infra signs off for Dedicated compatibility.
tom: i'll also run SDK unit tests against staging and post results here.
maria: timeline: plan to merge after infra + sdk thumbs. if either finds issues, we'll patch on the docs branch and cherry-pick to stable. thanks everyone :heart:
